correctness.rationale: The parametrization proves two coordinate relations; on v != 0 they force a smooth open graph with an explicit inverse. On H != 0 the source closure equals an irreducible hypersurface F=0 after G eliminates t. The Jacobian forces precisely v=u=a=t=0 and an invertible formal coordinate change takes F to UW+Z^3 for every point on the line. The attached SymPy certificate checks all defining identities, Groebner elimination, H=0 smoothness and the exact normal-form polynomial. The result is not asserted outside x0 != 0.

originality.rationale: The originating paper explicitly establishes the three-line singular support, but does not compute the complete local germ at points on the displayed line. A symbolic chart calculation and a formal coordinate change give a stronger distinct property than a set-theoretic singular-support list. Focused searches for the precise degree-eight example and transverse A2 type found no statement implying the classification. Other retrieved A2 local models address different varieties; they do not imply this one. This is a self-review, not exhaustive publication certification.

value.rationale: Han–Kwak’s singular multisecant counterexample is globally nonnormal with singular support three lines. Identifying the exact transverse A2 germ along an entire line determines local normality, rationality, Jacobian-scheme thickness and the local resolution configuration, beyond the paper’s set-theoretic description. This is a natural qualitative boundary for their singular geometry, and is useful for studying resolutions/normalization of this named example without an unsupported general theorem.
